# Fallout 76: Atlantic City - New update / expansion on December 5th, 2023 - Trailer and screenshots of the new expedition

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_174_nukaknights-post-atlantic-city.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

New article (11/13) Expected changes for Patch 48: Atlantic City / Season 15 on December 5th, 2023

UPDATE 09/21/2023: **Atlantic City is coming December 5th, 2023**

![Fallout 76 Atlantic City December 2023](/uploads/fo76-atlantic-city-dec2023.jpeg) 

More details about this:

Fallout 76: Atlantic City will be split into two parts, the first update will be available on December 5th, 2023.

- New factions
- New creatures
- New missions
- New rewards
- Plus a new casino where players can test their luck

The Atlantic City PTS will go online on October 3rd, 2023. There will then be more information and data mining.

Sources: @IdleSloth / Xbox.com

Original article:

Finally a sign of life from Fallout 76. Yesterday on June 11th, 2023 a new expansion for Fallout 76 was presented at the Xbox Showcase: **Atlantic City**

![Fallout 76 Atlantic City](/uploads/atlantic-city-announcement.jpg) 

Unfortunately, no specific date was given here, just “Coming Soon”.

## When is Atlantic City coming?

Season 12 is currently not over yet. June 13, 2023 was given as a possible update date at the beginning of the season. (Steam season end). There will now be other changes in Patch 44: New Cryptids, New Events, New Rewards, etc. See: Upcoming changes in the `When the Stars Align' update (`Once in a blue moon`) on June 13th, 2023 / Patch 44.

~~A content update appears once per quarter. Patch 44 is the 2nd quarter. So for~~ **Atlantic City** that leaves Q3 or Q4.

~~We will most likely find out whether it will be the 3rd quarter after the release of Patch 44 and the subsequent new PTS opening with the upcoming content for the following update. I would currently guess the 3rd quarter.~~

~~Update: There's a note in the Xbox Games Showcase Extended 2023 that Atlantic City isn't coming until "next year." So Atlantic City will be released in 2024. Let's hope for the first quarter of 2024.~~

Update: **Atlantic City will be released on December 5th, 2023**

## What is Atlantic City?

Atlantic City is an **expedition**. This much has already been announced. Of course, we don't yet know what exactly needs to be done there. However, there are a few things that can be seen in the trailer. You can see a **casino** and a **foggy port town** that is reminiscent of Far Harbor (Fallout 4). You also briefly see a **creature** that could be some kind of water or swamp monster.
